Our Founder

Bryson Berard's Inspirational Journey

In the heart of Lehigh Valley, Bryson Berard turned a dream into reality in 2017 when he opened the doors at In The Light Roofing. Bryson’s path to establishing his own roofing company was fueled by a lifelong passion for the roofing industry, supported by unwavering strength drawn from his faith, family, and friends. The foundation of In The Light Roofing was laid with a vision to not just offer roofing services but to encapsulate a sense of belonging and care for each client.

Read more about us

Our Crew

The Backbone of Every Project

In The Light Roofing’s team is a dynamic blend of seasoned expertise and innovative minds, all united by a common goal: to deliver roofing excellence with a personal touch. Each member brings a unique set of skills and a shared passion for quality craftsmanship, ensuring our services not only meet but exceed expectations.
We pride ourselves on our meticulous attention to detail, commitment to using the finest materials, and a customer-first approach that has earned us a stellar reputation across Lehigh Valley. Our team’s dedication to integrity, community service, and unmatched work ethic is the driving force behind our success and your satisfaction.

Our Process

01

Begin with a Call

Your journey to a new roof starts with a phone call, where we listen to your needs and start forming a plan tailored just for you.
02

Personalized Appointment

We meet you at your convenience to understand your vision and discuss the possibilities for your roofing project.
03

Customized Estimate

Receive a detailed, transparent estimate that respects your budget and outlines our high-quality services.
04

Seamless Pre-Production

We smoothly transition to the planning stage, securing your commitment with a deposit that marks the beginning of our exceptional craftsmanship.
05

The Big Day: Transforming Your Space

Experience the magic on production day as we turn your roofing dreams into reality, ensuring every detail is perfected to your satisfaction.
